Audio Speed Changer

Change audio speed from 0.5× to 2× with real resampling and export as WAV.

⏩ Drop an audio file here or click to browse
Pitch shifts naturally with speed, like a tape machine. New duration: —

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an audio file into the tool.
  2. Drag the speed slider from 0.5× to 2×.
  3. Click Download WAV to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the speed changed?

The samples are resampled with linear interpolation, so pitch shifts naturally with speed, like a tape machine.

Does pitch stay the same?

No — faster playback means higher pitch and shorter duration, exactly like speeding up a record.

What format is the download?

A 16-bit PCM WAV; the result panel shows the new duration.
